### Annual Report 2025

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1
percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

][159]
[
[nurse talking with patient at the bedsite]

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]
[
[A healthcare professional is shown standing proudly with a sustainable-produced medical container.]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]
[
[A medical laboratory employee is pouring liquid for a quality check.]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

][162]
[
[Digital microscope for neurosurgery named Aesculap Aeos® in front of a white background]

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

# Nobody does
# adaptive
# like **Elekta**

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

Your browser does not support HTML video..

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

# like **Elekta**

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

Your browser does not support HTML video..

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

2. Medtronic AI Compass
3. Medtronic AI Compass
4. Medtronic AI Compass

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

## Advanced brain scanning, out of the hospital and into the field.

ArcheOptix’s NIRD® (Near-Infrared Diffuse Reflectance) device is a lightweight, non-invasive
solution built for emergency responders, remote communities, sports medicine, and the military.
Backed by CT-level performance, NIRD® technology gives you the confidence to act quickly, when every
minute counts.

## 93% of Head CTs are Negative for Bleeding. Start Smarter.

The NIRD® uses near-infrared light to scan the brain for signs of bleeding after a traumatic
incident. By analyzing how the light interacts with brain tissue, our device can detect acute
hematomas in minutes.

## Accurately identify up to 98% of acute subdural and epidural hematomas in minutes.

ArcheOptix’s NIRD® technology gives frontline teams the clarity they need to make faster, smarter
decisions. Whether you’re in a rural clinic, an ambulance, or a military setting, it brings
hospital-grade insight to wherever care begins.

# BRAIN INJURY DETECTION,

# ANYWHERE.

### [How it Works ][17]

### [Request a Demo ][18]

Scroll Down

## Advanced brain scanning, out of the hospital and into the field.

ArcheOptix’s NIRD® (Near-Infrared Diffuse Reflectance) device is a lightweight, non-invasive
solution built for emergency responders, remote communities, sports medicine, and the military.
Backed by CT-level performance, NIRD® technology gives you the confidence to act quickly, when every
minute counts.

## 93% of Head CTs are Negative for Bleeding. Start Smarter.

The NIRD® uses near-infrared light to scan the brain for signs of bleeding after a traumatic
incident. By analyzing how the light interacts with brain tissue, our device can detect acute
hematomas in minutes.

## Accurately identify up to 98% of acute subdural and epidural hematomas in minutes.

ArcheOptix’s NIRD® technology gives frontline teams the clarity they need to make faster, smarter
decisions. Whether you’re in a rural clinic, an ambulance, or a military setting, it brings
hospital-grade insight to wherever care begins.

Provides rapid brain injury detection in military environments, enabling quicker decisions on
patient care and reducing unnecessary evacuations.

[ What types of diagnostic products does Astam Diagnostics manufacture?
][94]

[ Does Astam Diagnostics provide OEM and private label manufacturing services?
][95]

They offer end-to-end OEM and private label manufacturing services for IVD kits and medical devices,
custom-tailored to the formulations, packaging, branding, and regulatory compliance standards of
global healthcare brands.

 

[ What regulatory and quality certifications does your manufacturing facility hold?
][96]

The manufacturing plant operates under stringent international quality protocols. Astam Diagnostics
is ISO 13485:2016 certified, with products manufactured in compliance with CDSCO regulations and CE
certification standards.

 

[ How can global distributors or laboratories request a bulk supply or custom quote?
][97]

fill out the corporate enquiry form on the website or email the B2B procurement cell directly. The
company provides scalable logistics for both domestic (Pan-India) and international shipments.

[ Do you ensure batch-to-batch consistency for your biochemistry reagents and rapid kits?
][98]

The in-house R&D facility and quality assurance teams perform rigorous analytical and clinical
evaluations on every batch, guaranteeing exceptional sensitivity, specificity, and long-term
stability across all diagnostic products.

[ Where can individuals or small clinics buy retail quantities of your products online?

While the main website handles bulk corporate contracts, a dedicated e-commerce storefront is
available for retail orders. Small clinics, laboratories, and individual clients can purchase
selected medical devices at shop.astamdiagno.com.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ What types of diagnostic products does Astam Diagnostics manufacture?
][94]

Astam Diagnostics manufactures a wide range of In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) kits and medical devices,
including Biochemistry Reagents, Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits (Immunochromatography), Immunology kits,
and advanced laboratory consumables for hospitals and diagnostic centers.

 

[ Does Astam Diagnostics provide OEM and private label manufacturing services?
][95]

They offer end-to-end OEM and private label manufacturing services for IVD kits and medical devices,
custom-tailored to the formulations, packaging, branding, and regulatory compliance standards of
global healthcare brands.

 

[ What regulatory and quality certifications does your manufacturing facility hold?
][96]

The manufacturing plant operates under stringent international quality protocols. Astam Diagnostics
is ISO 13485:2016 certified, with products manufactured in compliance with CDSCO regulations and CE
certification standards.

 

[ How can global distributors or laboratories request a bulk supply or custom quote?
][97]

For wholesale distribution, laboratory tenders, or bulk supply requirements, interested parties can
fill out the corporate enquiry form on the website or email the B2B procurement cell directly. The
company provides scalable logistics for both domestic (Pan-India) and international shipments.

[ Do you ensure batch-to-batch consistency for your biochemistry reagents and rapid kits?
][98]

The in-house R&D facility and quality assurance teams perform rigorous analytical and clinical
evaluations on every batch, guaranteeing exceptional sensitivity, specificity, and long-term
stability across all diagnostic products.

[ Where can individuals or small clinics buy retail quantities of your products online?
][99]

While the main website handles bulk corporate contracts, a dedicated e-commerce storefront is
available for retail orders. Small clinics, laboratories, and individual clients can purchase
selected medical devices at shop.astamdiagno.com.

## Partner With a Trusted Diagnostic Manufacturer

Looking for a reliable supplier of rapid test kits and ELISA kits?
👉 Contact Astam Diagnostics today for bulk orders and partnerships.

## Why intracranial hemorrhage detection is vital at point of care?

**Intracranial hemorrhage detection**

**The key to complete point of care testing of trauma patients**

Point-of-care diagnosis is key to providing early treatment. A fast and non-invasive screening test
of trauma patients at the site results in fast triaging which allows for significantly improved
diagnostics and treatment process.

But complete point-of-care testing that tests for brain injury remains elusive today because the
head trauma patients are missed during triage in case the patient has sustained no external injuries
or is not exhibiting any clinical symptom.

Glasgow coma scale has proved to be a very effective triaging methodology in acute traumatic brain
injury when a patient is presented with clinical symptoms, however it remains inconclusive in mild
traumatic brain injury especially when the patients are asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic due to
technology barrier that can detect an injury in absence of symptoms. Once this is solved, a complete
point of care diagnosis of trauma patients will become possible.

Each year more than 50 million suffer from traumatic brain injury in the world and $76.5 billion are
spent by the US alone in management of these patients.

Patients wait for several hours before clinical symptoms arise, and doctors sometimes make critical
decisions with incomplete information.

Although CT scanners are very reliable diagnostic tools for intracranial hemorrhage detection, these
cannot be deployed onsite for mass screening owing to their infrastructure requirement, exposure to
ionizing radiation and need of a radiologist, which creates a huge demand for an objective
assessment of the injury with a portable device that can be used by a paramedic or semi skilled
staff.

Cerebo combines class-leading detection accuracy with ease-of-use, compact design, and pricing
tailored to the point-of-care market. Our solution takes minutes to run, can be performed by a
technician with minimal training and doesn't require cumbersome testing setup to generate the
result.

## Is it or Is it Not?

[brain internal bleeding]

It's 3 am and a family visits the trauma centre, they have met with an accident. They all have some
external bruises and the kid has a mild headache. Is it serious? Do you need to rush them to urgent
care, to the CT scan, or neither? Is it worth risking the delay if you aren’t sure? Cerebo helps
answer these questions by letting you know if the brain is bleeding internally. Right when you need
it. Right at the site.

Play Video
Play Video

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video
Play Video
09:22

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.
[ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK in
1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not overshadow this
| 06/1/26]
Play Video
Play Video
15:58

### ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK
### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.
[ASCO 2026: Known for its leadership in antibody-drug conjugates, Daiichi Sankyo's US CEO and new
Head of Global R&D discuss ASCO data and investments it will be making throughout oncology |

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes

neck | 05/31/26]

05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the

Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.

### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.

| 06/02/26]

### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.

### overshadow this | 06/1/26

and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.

# The Comprehensive Solution to Traumatic Brain Injury

**Led by pioneers in the industry, BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach is creating the new
gold standard.**

## Our Approach

The BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach aims to aid clinicians with diagnosis of mTBI and
provide information regarding the likelihood of symptoms post injury.

Our approach includes blood biomarker panels that are available on both a point of care instrument

## What is a BCI and why?

Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are systems which can isolate specific brain signals to interpret
cognitive and sensory-motor functions into physical movement for patients who suffer from paralysis.

## Background

According to the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Center, there are about 11,000 new cases of
spinal cord injury every year  and 270,000 victims residing in the United States. With this issue at
hand, BrainCheck is dedicated to redefining brain computer interfaces by addressing reliability with
an emphasis on portability.  BrainCheck is composed of experienced innovators striving to develop
and design improvements within BCI technology with a focus on restoring hand gestures.

## Mission

The perspectives and values of BrainCheck were moulded by the collaborative minds of biomedical and
materials science engineers from the University of California, Irvine. Our mission is to empower
paralyzed patients to regain hand movements with the assistance of our portable, affordable, and
user-friendly brain computer interface.

## What is a BCI and why?

Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are systems which can isolate specific brain signals to interpret
cognitive and sensory-motor functions into physical movement for patients who suffer from paralysis.

## Background

According to the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Center, there are about 11,000 new cases of
spinal cord injury every year  and 270,000 victims residing in the United States. With this issue at
hand, BrainCheck is dedicated to redefining brain computer interfaces by addressing reliability with
an emphasis on portability.  BrainCheck is composed of experienced innovators striving to develop
and design improvements within BCI technology with a focus on restoring hand gestures.

## Mission

The perspectives and values of BrainCheck were moulded by the collaborative minds of biomedical and
materials science engineers from the University of California, Irvine. Our mission is to empower
paralyzed patients to regain hand movements with the assistance of our portable, affordable, and
user-friendly brain computer interface.

# Expert Care

Leveraging our cutting-edge technology, we ensure the highest standards of care in TBI diagnosis and
assessment. Early diagnosis plays a pivotal role in TBI management and recovery. The identification
of injuries allows us to create and implement treatment plans, reducing the long term impact of
TBI. 

Quickly diagnosing allows us to create and implement treatment plans, reducing the long-term impact
of TBI.

## Diagnostic Services

Our comprehensive diagnostic services for TBI encompass the following
[Image]

### Imaging Tests

Utilizing state-of-the-art technology Functional Testing: Assessing brain function and cognitive
abilities, including memory, attention, and problem-solving skills.

[Image]

### Neuropsychological Assessments

Comprehensive evaluations covering intelligence, memory, attention, processing speed, executive
function, language, and social cognition.

[Image]

### Imaging Vestibular and Balance Assessments

Evaluating balance, spatial orientation, and eye-head coordination.

[Image]

### Eye Tracking Assessments

Measuring eye movement responses to gain insights into brain function.

[Image]

### Clinical History and Physical Examination

Thorough medical history and physical examination to uncover underlying conditions contributing to
symptoms.

[Image]

### Psychological Evaluations

Assessing emotional well-being and mental health.

## Diagnostic Services

Our comprehensive diagnostic services for TBI encompass the following
[Image]

### Eye Tracking

FDA-cleared eye-tracking assessments that objectively measure eye movements and brain function to
help identify potential neurological impairment after injury.

[Image]

### VNG

Comprehensive vestibular test that evaluates inner ear and balance system function as well as
cognitive impairments.

[Image]

### CNS

Objective measurements of cognitive performance, including memory, attention processing speed, and
executive function, to help identify changes following brain injury.

[Image]

### Biomarkers

Blood based brain injury biomarkers analyze specific proteins released after head trauma, offering
additional objective data to support diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

[Image]

### DTI

Advanced MRI technique that evaluated microscopic changes in brain white matter, helping detect
structural injury that may not appear on conventional imaging.

TBI symptoms can vary in severity and may include headache, dizziness, nausea, fatigue, memory
issues, mood changes, and more.
▸How long after an injury does TBI occur?
TBI can manifest immediately or develop over days or weeks, known as secondary TBI.
▸How long does the diagnostic process take?
The duration varies based on individual needs, but we prioritize delivering timely and accurate
diagnoses.

FDA-cleared eye-tracking assessments that objectively measure eye movements and brain function to
help identify potential neurological impairment after injury.

[Image]

### VNG

Comprehensive vestibular test that evaluates inner ear and balance system function as well as
cognitive impairments.

[Image]

### CNS

Objective measurements of cognitive performance, including memory, attention processing speed, and
executive function, to help identify changes following brain injury.

[Image]

### Biomarkers

Blood based brain injury biomarkers analyze specific proteins released after head trauma, offering
additional objective data to support diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

[Image]

### DTI

Advanced MRI technique that evaluated microscopic changes in brain white matter, helping detect
structural injury that may not appear on conventional imaging.

FAQ

## Your Questions Answered

Some answers to common questions that clients ask about TBI and the diagnostic process
[
Get Started
][9]
▸What are the symptoms of TBI?
TBI symptoms can vary in severity and may include headache, dizziness, nausea, fatigue, memory
issues, mood changes, and more.
▸How long after an injury does TBI occur?
TBI can manifest immediately or develop over days or weeks, known as secondary TBI.
▸How long does the diagnostic process take?
The duration varies based on individual needs, but we prioritize delivering timely and accurate
diagnoses.

# 
# Offering Real Hope After Brain Injury

Our Mission is to Advocate, Educate, and Serve all Affected by Brain Injury

# **Welcome to BIHN**

We offer a supportive community for anyone impacted by brain injury including resources that help
survivors and caregivers find understanding, healing, and empowerment. Connect with our community,
share experiences, and explore real stories of resilience and hope. No one walks this path alone.

[Survivor Resources][31] [For Caregivers][32]

#### ** Connecting Us**

BIHN Community brings together more than 55,000 survivors, caregivers, and families. Through shared
experience, members connect with others who understand.

[ Join the Community][33]

#### ** Ending Isolation**

BIHN Support provides real time peer support through our virtual support groups. Each year thousands
attend to share experiences, build connection, and find strength together.

[View Support Groups][34]

#### ** Educating Us**

BIHN Education offers monthly learning sessions featuring professionals and survivor presenters who
share practical strategies for living well after brain injury.

[ Explore Education][35]

# Listen to Voices of Resilience: Audio Stories from the Heart

Explore our audio stories, where resilience and courage find their voice. These narratives provide a
glimpse into the lives of those affected by brain injury, highlighting their struggles, victories,
and hope. Ideal for anyone seeking inspiration, comfort, or community, our audio stories offer a
chance to listen, reflect, and connect. They're perfect for when you want to absorb storytelling
hands-free or just immerse in the journey of others.

[Listen to Stories][36]
[Brain Injury Hope Magazine]

### **Join Our Monthly Online Support Groups**

Join us for our BIHN Brain Injury Support Groups on Zoom, where we offer two distinct meetings each
month designed to support different members of the brain injury community. These sessions are a
chance to share experiences, gain understanding, and connect with others facing similar challenges
in a supportive and welcoming environment.

[Learn More][37]
[Brain Injury Hope Magazine]

### **Community Resources for Brain Injury Caregivers**

Being a caregiver is challenging, but you don’t have to face it alone. Our in-person and online
support groups are here to offer you connection, understanding, and guidance. Whether you need
someone to talk to, practical advice, or just a community that gets it, we’re here for you. Discover
our gatherings, social communities, and resources that make caregiving a bit more manageable and
supported.

[Learn More][38]
[bihn]

#### ** Our Facebook Family**

One of the world's largest online social communities offering support to those affected by brain
injury. 

[ Learn More ][39]
[Brain Injury books]

#### ** Brain Injury Books**

Browse the best brain injury books as recommended by survivors and those who love them!

[ Learn More ][40]
[brain injury blog]

#### ** BIHN Blog**

*Community Voices* is the official blog of BIHN, featuring survivor stories that remind us that
recovery is possible.

[ View Blog][41]

## Celebrating 13 Years of Hope!

BIHN celebrated a significant milestone on January 4th, 2026, commemorating twelve years of
dedicated service. We take pride in being the world's most engaged community, providing
comprehensive support to everyone impacted by brain injuries.

Our network is a welcoming space for survivors, their families, caregivers, and anyone seeking to
understand more about brain injuries. We warmly invite you to join us on this journey of hope,
healing, and learning.

[Join Us on Facebook>>>][42]

[Mobirise]

# Sign Up for Updates!

Stay connected with BIHN through our email newsletter. Sign up now to receive updates directly to
your inbox, including notifications of new stories shared by our community, reminders for upcoming
support group meetings, information on events, and much more.

# Offering Real Hope After Brain Injury

Our Mission is to Advocate, Educate, and Serve all Affected by Brain Injury

# **Welcome to BIHN**

We offer a supportive community for anyone impacted by brain injury including resources that help
survivors and caregivers find understanding, healing, and empowerment. Connect with our community,
share experiences, and explore real stories of resilience and hope. No one walks this path alone.

[Survivor Resources][31] [For Caregivers][32]

#### ** Connecting Us**

BIHN Community brings together more than 55,000 survivors, caregivers, and families. Through shared
experience, members connect with others who understand.

[ Join the Community][33]

#### ** Ending Isolation**

BIHN Support provides real time peer support through our virtual support groups. Each year thousands
attend to share experiences, build connection, and find strength together.

[View Support Groups][34]

#### ** Educating Us**

BIHN Education offers monthly learning sessions featuring professionals and survivor presenters who
share practical strategies for living well after brain injury.

[ Explore Education][35]

glimpse into the lives of those affected by brain injury, highlighting their struggles, victories,
and hope. Ideal for anyone seeking inspiration, comfort, or community, our audio stories offer a
chance to listen, reflect, and connect. They're perfect for when you want to absorb storytelling
hands-free or just immerse in the journey of others.

in a supportive and welcoming environment.

# World leading supplier of innovative medical technology for patient monitoring

Since 1987, Compumedics’ strategy has focused on developing its core competency – Sleep Diagnostics
– which has enabled the company to become one of the leaders in this growing international
healthcare market. Today, Compumedics has evolved into one of the world’s leading suppliers of
medical technology for sleep and neuro diagnostics (including brain research) and ultrasonic blood
flow monitoring.

Compumedics’ technologies and products are distributed to clients around the globe, helping millions
of people who suffer from debilitating sleep, neurological and other healthcare problems.

Compumedics is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since 2000 – ASX: CMP.

released many world’s first and  continues to be at the forefront of leading edge diagnostics.

Research & Development

Compumedics believes that it has remained at the forefront of the physiological data
recording/diagnostics market by maintaining an active research and development program. Compumedics
has a highly skilled research team and has developed significant intellectual property. These
resources, together with the Medical Advisory Board allow the company to continue to develop the
best diagnostic products for the medical market.

To ensure that there is a regular pipeline of new and innovative products, the Company has
established a dedicated innovation group. The role of the Innovation Group is to work closely with
the Medical Advisory Board and the medical and research communities in identifying future product
trends, paradigm shifts in technology and health decrease trends.

flow monitoring.

 Cortex are developing neuro sensors and brain computer interface headsets to provide at-home
neurofeedback  therapy sessions for people with autism, ADHD, brain injury and mental illness.

[More][33]

## Photo Gallery

## Our Why

#### Our Founders

** Casey Pfluger** is both founder and end-user of Cortex technology.  He and his daughter both have
autism and ADHD.  With Casey's experience spanning over 20 years in medical research and
application, the Cortex team is determined to deliver a product that is both financially accessible
and highly beneficial. 



**Amy-Rose Goodey** is a strong advocate for accessible technologies for the benefit of humanity.
Her career spans many industries including disability services, education and technology.



 

#### The Numbers

More than 4 million Australians have a disability. The autism prevalence rate is up by an estimated
40% to 1 in 70 people and around 1 in every 20 children in Australia has symptoms of ADHD.  There is
no cure for autism, nor is there any medical treatment. 

#### Current Technologies

With the current application of neurofeedback for Autism and ADHD being an expensive undertaking,
Cortex aims to deliver an in-home BCI headset, that is both affordable, convenient and effective.

no cure for autism, nor is there any medical treatment. 

#### Current Technologies

With the current application of neurofeedback for Autism and ADHD being an expensive undertaking,
Cortex aims to deliver an in-home BCI headset, that is both affordable, convenient and effective.

Cortirio’s mission is to save lives by developing low-cost, portable brain imaging. Our wearable
headset uses infrared light to map blood and automatically detect stroke and traumatic brain injury.

imaging in a portable and wearable device. Like computer-aided tomography did for X-ray, we are
leveraging advances in technology to push an established technique for examining the brain to new
levels.

  soil, and light, are linked to an increased risk of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

  Learn how to identify the most common forms of hair loss.

  childhood. Although many of these are benign and self-limited, some require an extensive workup
  and close monitoring.

  healthcare settings, significantly impacting daily life. They range from mild illnesses to severe
  diseases such as pneumonia and meningitis.

  symptoms can be challenging. Delays in diagnosis and treatment may result in serious
  complications, including abdominal catastrophes.

# Accessible imaging, for every patient, everywhere

We aim to revolutionise stroke care worldwide.

# Developing a world first portable brain scanner

Bringing electromagnetic neurodiagnostics to the scene.
[ Learn more ][17]

## Bringing neurodiagnostics to the point-of-care

When stroke is suspected, rapid diagnosis is critical. Our world-first bedside electromagnetic
imaging device readily delivers imaging to the patient. Fast, AI-powered identification of stroke
type accelerates the appropriate treatment to better conserve brain matter.
[ How it works ][18]

## Bringing neurodiagnostics to the patient, wherever they are

###### Portable

Easily manoeuvred, easily stored, just like a cart Ultrasound

###### Safe

No ionizing radiation, no ferromagnetism, no special infrastructure or shielding requirements

###### Bedside operation

Perform scans at the bedside, without needing to move equipment or transport the patient

###### Fast

Scans and neurodiagnostic output obtained in just a few minutes

###### Easy to operate

One headset for all head sizes, simple pre-set positioning, push to scan

#### emu^{™} Brain Scanner

Detect clinically significant changes, at the bedside, when time matters.

#### First Responder Brain Scanner

Ultra light weight device embedded in standard road and air ambulances to deliver pre-hospital
stroke diagnosis and care to patients regardless of location.

Disclaimer: Neither the emu^{™} or first responder devices are available for sale or clinical use.
The devices’ safety, effectiveness and compliance
with regulatory requirements have not yet been evaluated by any regulatory authority.

## latest** CUSTOMER CASES**
* [Beauty Salon Customer - Serbia]
  Providing a commercial hyperbaric oxygen chamber solution for a renowned beauty salon in Serbia.
  Includes both reclining and seated hyperbaric chambers, aiming to offer an advanced and
  comfortable hyperbaric oxygen therapy experience for beauty care.
  [Beauty Salon Customer - Serbia][65]
* [Wellness Center - USA]
  The Wellness Center in the USA has opted for our 2ATA hard-shell hyperbaric chamber HP2202,
  offering HBOT for rehabilitation treatments, providing innovative hyperbaric oxygen therapy for
  patients to aid in recovery and overall health.
  [Wellness Center - USA][66]
* [Olympic Champion-Jovana Prekovic]
  At the beginning of 2021, we were contacted by a sports team from Serbia who signed a contract
  with the Olympic Federation. After many consultations, they finally chose our MACY-PAN hyperbaric
  oxygen chamber and purchased the HP1501 hard chamber for their athletes, including karate athlete
  Jovana Prekovic. Jovana has won the world and European championship in the 61kg category. After
  using it for a period of time, Jovana won the gold medal in the 61kg category of the women's
  karate event at the Tokyo Olympics!
  [Olympic Champion-Jovana Prekovic][67]
* Renowned DJ and music producer Steve Aoki has joined the MACY-PAN family with our advanced hard
  hyperbaric oxygen chamber. Sharing his experience on social media, Aoki described the chamber as a
  "game changer" for him and his brain. As a global icon in the music industry, Aoki values the
  importance of mental clarity and recovery, and we are honored to support his wellness journey with
  our innovative technology. Renowned DJ Steve Aoki - USA
* [Clinic in New Zealand]
  Implemented our 1.5ATA hard-shell hyperbaric chamber, support the clinic's medical team in various
  rehabilitation and treatment plans.
  [Clinic in New Zealand][68]
* [Home User - USA]
  A senior customer has chosen our MC4000 wheelchair chamber for lung issues recovery, enhancing her
  quality of life.
  [Home User - USA][69]
* [Football Team - Paraguay ]
  The football team in Paraguay trusts our hyperbaric oxygen chamber for sports recovery. It will
  offer quick and effective recovery for athletes, ensuring they maintain optimal performance during
  matches.
  [Football Team - Paraguay ][70]
* [Home User - Switzerland]
  Swiss home users have selected our ST2200 sitting hyperbaric chamber to help with insomnia,
  fatigue, and pain. Our hyperbaric oxygen chamber provide her with a natural, non-invasive recovery
  option, assisting in improving sleep and alleviating physical discomfort.
  [Home User - Switzerland][71]
* [Home User - Slovakia]
  I am very happy to have found a great Chinese company Macy-Pan and to have been able to buy a
  great hyperbaric chamber ST1700 from Macy-Pan. This HBO chamber was delivered to me in excellent
  quality and works great. I am very grateful to firm Macy-Pan for this HBO chamber. And I'm also
  grateful for the great business communication that help me a good decision to buy a great HBO
  chamber from MACY-PAN. Thank you very much.
  [Home User - Slovakia][72]

## what **speak people**

  Customer from France
  My experience overall with MACY-PAN has been excellent. I've done 150 HBOT sessions, have more
  energy, and the kind of energy l have has changed - its like its a more stable and lucid energy. I
  was really quite low in all kinds of ways when I started the sessions, and now feel good in
  general, able to work long days of physical labour and not my back pain has healed up as well.

  I received the hyperbaric chamber! Everything went very well with the shipping and customs. When
  the packages arrived, I was amazed at how well and carefully everything was packed! I give you a 5
  star rating (the maximum) for the shipping and packaging! When I opened the boxes, I was so happy
  to discover the excellent quality of your products!!!! I checked everything! The materials that
  you use are of very good quality. You are really professionals!!!! Congratulations on such
  outstanding customer service. Because of all these, please be sure, that I will recommend you to
  all my friends!!!
* [Customer from Italy]
  Customer from Italy
  Thanks much for your excellent service as usual and your follow up message. My wife and daughter
  did notice a significant amount of bodies heating up not so afraid of cold weather right after
  using it and every time my wife used it. She felt really energetic afterwards, so in that respect,
  our family is already benefit from it. I'm sure as time goes by, we'll have more good stories to
  share with you.
* [Customer from Slovakia]
  Customer from Slovakia
  My whole chamber is very well made. The chamber can be perfectly served by 1 person from the
  inside, I will operate the chamber myself from the beginning of its use. Because my wife has very
  weak hands. There are 2 main zippers that seal the chamber and 1 zipper of the protective cover.
  All zippers can be served well inside and out. In my opinion, the price is excellent for great
  quality. I initaly looked at equivalent products from France and Austria and basicaly for a
  similar type of chamber there was 2 to 3 times higher price than from Macy Pan.
* [Customer from USA]
  Customer from USA
  It's a lot of fun for me because I basically fall asleep within 5 minutes, and it's been a very
  comforting experience. It takes away a lot of the stress that I have from other places that I've
  been at. The HBOT is good for me because it really helps me relax.

More than 60 million people worldwide sustain a concussion each year, with 50% going undetected or
undiagnosed (World Health Organization).

Missed concussions can delay recovery, raise the risk of re-injury, and contribute to long-term
neurological symptoms. Yet diagnosis still relies heavily on subjective testing—symptoms, balance,
and memory—rather than direct measurement of brain function.

Headsafe™'s Nurochek™ changes the paradigm.

## Frequently asked questions
* 01
  
  ### What is icometrix and what solutions does it offer?
  
  icometrix provides **AI-powered brain imaging solutions** for neurological disorders. Its
  portfolio is designed to help improve care in dementia and Alzheimer’s disease, multiple
  sclerosis, ARIA detection, brain trauma, stroke, epilepsy, tumors, and Parkinson’s disease.. The
  icometrix solutions **automatically detect, segment, and quantify brain structures and lesions**
  to support clinicians and researchers.
* 02
  
  ### How does icobrain AI help in brain imaging for neurological disorders?
  
  icobrain performs **automated detection and volumetric quantification** of lesions and brain
  structures, enabling clinicians to **monitor disease progression, evaluate treatment response, and
  make informed decisions**.
* 03
  
  ### Which neurological conditions can be analyzed with icobrain?
  
  icobrain supports analysis for **dementia & Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, stroke, traumatic
  brain injury, epilepsy, Parkinson’s disease, brain tumors, and ARIA monitoring**
* 04
  
  ### How does icobrain integrate with hospital workflows and PACS/EMR systems?
  
  Using **icobridge**, icobrain connects MRI scanners, PACS, and EMR systems. This enables **secure
  data transfer, automated report generation**, and clinician-friendly dashboards, streamlining the
  workflow.
* 05
  
  ### Is icobrain FDA-cleared or clinically validated?
  
  Yes. icobrain is **clinically validated with multiple peer-reviewed studies**, and certain modules
  have **regulatory clearance** where applicable, ensuring reliability in clinical practice.
* 06
  
  ### How does icobrain improve MRI reporting accuracy and efficiency?
  
  By automating detection and quantification, icobrain **reduces human error, saves radiologists
  time**, and provides objective metrics that improve **reporting accuracy and decision-making**.

# Complex Mental Health and Acquired Brain Injury service provider

[Services][6]

### About Us

### Maple House is a community based, purpose built, independent rehabilitation service for men with
### complex mental health needs including acquired brain injury. It is situated in the heart of
### Warrington with excellent transport links and is easily accessible. We focus on nurturing a
### positive and therapeutic environment that enables recovery and helps people fulfil their
### individual potential.

#### Services

Maple House is a 21 bed inpatient service that provides high quality, holistic, person-centred
rehabilitative care and specialised treatment for men with complex mental health needs due to mental
illness and/or acquired brain injury.

#### Our Goal

Our goal is to enable each of the men in our care to achieve meaningful and sustainable recovery and

conference

### Military Health System Research Symposium (MHSRS) Conference 2026

MTEC will be attending MHSRS! This is the premier military or civilian meeting that focuses
specifically on the unique medical needs of the Warfighter. The event provides a collaborative
setting for the exchange of information between military providers with deployment experience,
research and academic scientists, international partners, and industry on research and related
health care initiatives falling under the topic areas of Combat Casualty Care, Military Operational
Medicine, Clinical and Rehabilitative Medicine, Information Sciences, Military Infectious Diseases,
and the Radiation Health Effects. Learn more at https://www.mhsrs.net/

August 3, 2026

][47][

conference

### The MedTech Conference 2026 Hosted by AdvaMed

Join MTEC at Booth #629 and the New Pitch & Pour Start-Up Competition at The MedTech Conference 2025
This October, The MedTech Conference is bringing a fresh twist to Sunday afternoon with the Pitch &
Pour: Start-Up Competition & Happy Hour—a high-energy platform for early-stage companies innovating
in military health.

October 18, 2026

][48][
This event has ended

conference

### 10th Annual MTEC Membership Meeting

We’re excited to invite you to register for a milestone event—the 10th Annual MTEC Membership
Meeting! This year celebrates a decade of collaboration, innovation, and partnership with our
Government partners and the broader MTEC community. Over two dynamic days, attendees will engage in
networking, knowledge sharing, and strategic discussions that advance military medical innovation.
This is your opportunity to connect directly with industry peers, government stakeholders, and
academic leaders shaping the future of medical technology. Please note: Registration is open to MTEC
members only. Membership is required to attend this event and participate fully in consortium
programs.

June 16, 2026

# When Speed and Accuracy Matter, NanoDx™ Delivers

The NanoDx™ System is a first-of-its-kind diagnostic technology that combines nanotechnology and
biochemistry in a nano biosensor platform to address unmet testing needs.

### Clinical Value

Accelerate treatment decisions with accurate, real-time test results.

### Operational Value

Treat more patients in less time and bring the test to the patient.

### Financial Value

Reduce costly lab testing, avoid unnecessary diagnostic procedures.

### Health Equity

Bring accurate testing to both developed and underserved areas.

### Rapid Innovation

New test applications developed in just 6 to 9 months.

### Versatility

From military use to urgent care to sports medicine and more.

## One Platform, Multiple Applications

Patented nano biosensor technology enables accurate detection of biomarkers with a small blood
sample, in minutes. Extensive multiplexing capability and readily adjustable biomarker panel
configuration enable applications across a wide range of clinical indications.

[Learn More][24]

**Potential Future Applications (Directional)**

## First Focus: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI)

Our TBI test, the first in an expanding portfolio, addresses the need for an accurate, quantitative
assessment of brain injury.* It replaces subjective evaluation with a real-time measurement of three
key TBI biomarkers.

[Learn More about TBI][25]

## Believing in Recovery for More Than 45 Years

Centre for Neuro Skills^{®} was founded on the philosophy that patients never stop improving. Our
specially trained clinicians and rehabilitation teams create individualized treatment plans and
define success based on who our patients were before they required rehabilitation. The results have
made us a world leader in neuro rehab.

We’re proud to offer therapeutic rehabilitation and disease management services for individuals
recovering from acquired and traumatic brain injury, and we’re even prouder that no two of our
rehabilitation plans are ever the same.

[ Read More ][135]

The BIAA honored Dr. Mark J. Ashley, Founder and Executive Chairman of the Board of CNS, as Luminary
of the Year at the National Press Club in Washington, D.C. The annual award celebrates individuals
who have made outstanding contributions to the field of brain injury. The event shines a spotlight

# About Brain Injury

Brain injury can occur in many ways. Traumatic brain injuries typically result from accidents in
which the head is struck; however, other brain injuries, including those caused by a cerebral
vascular accident, insufficient oxygen, poisoning, or infection, can cause similar deficits.

[ Read More ][138]

# Interested in working at CNS?

Whether you're drawn to hands-on patient care, clinical practice, or vital behind-the-scenes
support, Centre for Neuro Skills offers a wide range of career paths with purpose. From Neuro
Rehabilitation Specialists to therapists, case managers, administrative staff, and more, every team
member plays a role in helping patients rebuild their lives.

# About Brain Injury

Brain injury can occur in many ways. Traumatic brain injuries typically result from accidents in
which the head is struck; however, other brain injuries, including those caused by a cerebral
vascular accident, insufficient oxygen, poisoning, or infection, can cause similar deficits.

Physiopedia is the world’s leading online knowledge platform for physiotherapy and rehabilitation
professionals. It brings together evidence-based clinical content, practical resources, and
continuing education to support learning, decision-making, and better patient outcomes. Built and
reviewed by qualified clinicians worldwide, Physiopedia helps students, educators, and practitioners
stay current, confident, and connected in an evolving profession.

## About Physiopedia

Physiopedia is the world’s leading online knowledge platform for physiotherapy and rehabilitation
professionals. It brings together evidence-based clinical content, practical resources, and
continuing education to support learning, decision-making, and better patient outcomes. Built and
reviewed by qualified clinicians worldwide, Physiopedia helps students, educators, and practitioners
stay current, confident, and connected in an evolving profession.

## Guard Health with Diagnostic Innovation

Nanjing Poclight Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Poclight Biotechnology") is an
innovative and R&D enterprise focusing on the development of in vitro medical diagnosis (IVD)
platform. We have R&D and production site of 5,000 ㎡, including more than 4,800 ㎡ of GMP workshops
of 10,000 level and 100,000 level.

* [In-Clinic Test for Human]
  
  ## In-Clinic Test for Human
  
  Poclight’s chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) solutions, including freeze-dried reagent beads,
  offer rapid and reliable biomarker detection without the need for cold chain logistics. With over
  35 tests available, results are delivered in just 3–15 minutes—minimizing sample degradation,
  saving send-out costs, and enabling real-time diagnosis. Designed for simplicity and efficiency,
  Poclight analyzers feature easy calibration and low reagent consumption, making them ideal for
  point-of-care where speed and accuracy matter most.
  [View More About][78]

  ## In-Clinic Test for Veterinary
  
  Poclight’s veterinary CLIA solution delivers fast, accurate pet diagnostics with 14 biomarker
  tests and results in minutes. Freeze-dried reagents require no cold chain, reducing costs and
  delays. Compact analyzers with easy calibration help clinics offer professional, in-house
  testing—speeding up treatment and improving care quality.

# Portapps

Collection of portable apps for Windows [   Apps ][8] [   Github ][9]

## What is Portapps ?

**Portapps** is a collection of [portable applications][10] for Windows. You can download your
favorite application as a portable setup or a 7z archive. Each portable app is executed through a
wrapper `[appname]-portable.exe` written in [Golang][11].

It is free and open source and always will be . All kinds of contributions are welcome ! The most
basic way to show your support is to star the project, or to raise issues You can also support this
project by [**becoming a sponsor on GitHub**][12] or by making a [Paypal donation][13] to ensure
this journey continues indefinitely!

#### about Precision MRI Group

## We are the ultimate in convenience and technology.

At Precision MRI Group, we place a strong focus on patient safety, comfort, and quality care. Our
friendly and knowledgeable team creates a calm and professional environment, ensuring every patient
feels supported throughout their visit. We are proud to offer advanced MRI services along with DTI
(Diffusion Tensor Imaging), a specialized form of imaging that provides detailed insights into brain
structure and neurological conditions.

Our Board Certified Radiologist delivers accurate MRI and DTI reports within 24 to 48 hours, with
immediate processing available for urgent cases. To make your experience even more convenient, we
offer free transportation upon request and flexible scheduling, including late evening and weekend
appointments to fit your lifestyle.

With English, Spanish, and Creole-speaking staff, we are here to assist with all your medical
imaging needs and ensure clear communication every step of the way. At Precision MRI Group, our goal
is to make your MRI and DTI experience as smooth and stress-free as possible. Call our caring team
today to schedule your appointment!

[ More About Us ][29]
[Precision MRI]
what we do

## Comprehensive MRI and DTI Scans

Precision MRI provides advanced diagnostic imaging using state-of-the-art MRI technology for
accurate and timely results. Our services support neurological, musculoskeletal, and whole-body
imaging with a focus on patient comfort and precise clinical insight.

### GE HiField 1.5 MRI

The GE HiField 1.5 Tesla MRI system provides high-resolution imaging for accurate diagnosis. It
supports neuro, musculoskeletal, and abdominal imaging with faster scans, improved comfort, and
clear results for confident treatment planning.

[ View Details ][30]
[ [Diffusion Tensor Imaging] ][31]

### Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI)

Precision MRI is expanding its neurological imaging with Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI), an advanced
MRI technique used to evaluate traumatic brain injury, stroke, neurodegenerative disease, and
complex neurological conditions not visible on standard MRI.

[ View Details ][32]
[ [Inclusivity in Imaging: Navigating Open MRI for Bariatric and Plus-Size Patients] ][33]

### Tesla MRI

Tesla MRI systems, including 1.5T and 3T, provide exceptional image clarity for accurate diagnosis.
Higher-strength 3T imaging captures fine details, supporting advanced detection in oncology,
cardiology, and functional imaging for more precise, personalized care.

[ View Details ][34]

## What Our MRI Centers Offer

Visit one of our four offices conveniently located throughout South Florida. We have offices in
Pembroke Pines, Cypress Creek, Lake Worth and Port St. Lucie.

### LATE NIGHT & WEEKEND APPOINTMENTS

Our caring personnel will schedule your MRI appointment at a time that best accommodates your needs.
Even if it’s after hours or on a weekend.

### SAME DAY APPOINTMENTS AVAILABLE

Precision MRI’s Board Certified Radiologist offers a 24-48 hour turnaround time on your MRI report,
with immediate results available upon request.

### TRANSPORTATION PROVIDED ON REQUEST

We place a high premium on providing the utmost in quality patient care. That’s why we offer free
transportation for our patients.

FREE E-BOOK

## Take Control of Your Health Today!

Experience the difference with Precision MRI Group. Schedule your MRI with us and benefit from our
expertise, efficiency, convenience, and personalized care. Don’t wait prioritize your health and
well-being now.

[ Contact Us ][35]

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ### About Mental Health America

Mental Health America (MHA) – founded in 1909 – is the nation’s leading community-based nonprofit
dedicated to addressing the needs of those living with mental illness and to promoting the overall
mental health of all Americans. Our work is driven by our commitment to promote mental health as a
critical part of overall wellness, including prevention services for all; early identification and
intervention for those at risk; integrated care, services, and supports for those who need it; with
recovery as the goal.

MHA Screening is made possible through the generous contributions of individuals and organizations
that share our vision of mental health for all. This program is supported, in part, through
philanthropic contributions from Abbvie, Alkermes, Elevance Health Foundation, Johnson & Johnson,
The NFL Foundation, Sage Therapeutics, Takeda Lundbeck Alliance, and Teva.

recovery as the goal.

## Welcome to StressTherapy Solutions

 



StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is an educational marketing company; specializing in workshops and
lectures on the subjects of biofeedback, EEG (electroencephalograph) brainwave training, QEEG
(Quantitative electroencephalograph), Database Guided Training, sLORETA Training, clinical ethics
and marketing guidance, personal mind fitness, and brainwave monitored meditation and neurofeedback
(EEG biofeedback) use in the clinical setting.

Since the 1980s, we have facilitated training and education by choosing independent specialists:
First with allopathics, then expanding to the neurofeedback community in 2001, to present workshops
to licensed practitioners, researchers, and educators. StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is the only
company to introduce the Global Neurofeedback Initiative, a collective that aims to promote
worldwide excellence, certification, and consistency in neurofeedback education.

lectures on the subjects of biofeedback, EEG (electroencephalograph) brainwave training, QEEG

## Why Choose Swope, Rodante P.A.

We aren’t afraid to take cases to trial if the defendant, or their insurance carrier, is unwilling
to offer a fair settlement.

As trial lawyers, we are known in the community for our tenacity in the courtroom and we have a
proven track record of success. We intensely review evidence and expert testimony to ensure our
clients have the best opportunity to obtain a positive verdict.

We have an appellate team led by board-certified appellate lawyer Brent Steinberg to handle appeals
in-house. Only about 200 of the more than 17,000 attorneys in the state of Florida have the Florida
Bar appellate practice board certification.

Our attorneys are driven by our commitment to helping clients restore their quality of life. Holding
people and businesses liable when their negligence causes an injury is an important part of making
our community safer for families.

We often handle cases at the cutting edge of Florida personal injury law, and we closely monitor
court rulings across the state to anticipate how new precedents may affect our cases. The partners
at our law firm regularly host seminars for the [Florida Justice Association][56] and other
professional organizations to share strategy and case law updates with attorneys at other firms.

In addition to the respect we have earned from our colleagues, our law firm and lawyers have
received numerous awards and positive ratings from legal organizations.

Firm partners [Dale Swope][59], [Angela Rodante][60], [Brent Steinberg][61], and [Daniel Greene][62]
have earned the [AV Preeminent rating][63] from Martindale-Hubbell, which is one of the most
prestigious awards a lawyer can receive for their legal ability. Our attorneys are also regularly
recognized by [Super Lawyers][64] and have 5-star ratings from [AVVO][65].

We are industry leaders in personal injury law and have built a strong community of Florida
plaintiff’s attorneys who turn to us for advice on handling catastrophic injury cases and [insurance
bad faith][66] claims.

### **TCA Venture Group: Catalyzing the Startup Ecosystem**

TCA Venture Group (TCA), formerly known as Tech Coast Angels, is headquartered in Southern
California, plays a pivotal role in fueling the growth of the startup ecosystem. With approximately
400 members and five angel funds, TCA has the resources and expertise to support startups through
seed, bridge, and early A-round funding.

TCA seeks companies with innovative solutions to meaningful problems—those that offer clear,
sustainable, and differentiated advantages. Our investments span a wide range of industries (see our
portfolio for details).

Beyond funding, TCA provides early-stage entrepreneurs with the critical tools for success:
connections, mentorship, knowledge, and operational support. While we work with startups across the
U.S. and Canada, we prioritize supporting California-based entrepreneurs with bold, game-changing
ideas.

Through our affiliation with over 50 angel groups nationwide, TCA has the ability to syndicate
deals, further amplifying the opportunities we create for startups.

**If you are an Entrepreneur seeking funding, let us help you to turn your vision into a sustainable
and successful business.**

would like to become a member.**

* One of the largest and most active angel investment organizations in the U.S.

* Affiliation with the **[Angel Syndication Network][76]** and **[Pegasus Angel Accelerator][77]**

[ [In this episode of TCA Crossroads, David Friedman and Dave Berkus discuss what separates
investment-ready startups from those that are prematurely seeking capital. The conversation
highlights the importance of preparation, including building a credible team, validating
product-market fit, understanding customers, developing a concise elevator pitch, and establishing
realistic valuations before approaching investors. The hosts emphasize that investors fund execution
and evidence, not just ideas, and that founders who demonstrate focus, market understanding, and
coachability significantly improve their chances of raising capital. The discussion also explores
why investors frequently decline opportunities, including unrealistic financial projections, lack of
competitive analysis, poor capital planning, and founders who are unwilling to accept feedback.
Berkus and Friedman stress that entrepreneurs must understand the investment thesis of the investors
they are approaching and align their pitch accordingly. Key takeaways include the importance of
customer validation, realistic fundraising expectations, capital efficiency, and building long-term
relationships with investors rather than viewing fundraising as a transactional process.]
Working with Early-Stage Investors: The Right Way and the Wrong Way
][82]
[ [In this episode of TCA Crossroads, Dave Berkus and David Friedman explore one of the most
important—and often misunderstood—topics in entrepreneurship: founder compensation. Drawing on data
from Pilot's Fifth Annual Startup Founder Salary Report covering nearly 1,850 startups, they discuss
how founder salaries have shifted in response to a tougher fundraising environment and increased
focus on capital efficiency. The conversation highlights key findings, including declining founder
pay, the rise in bootstrapped companies, differences across funding stages, team sizes, industries,
and geographies, and the premium currently commanded by AI-related ventures. The discussion provides
valuable context for understanding how compensation should evolve as companies grow from pre-seed
through later stages. For entrepreneurs, the key takeaway is that compensation should be tied to the
company's stage, cash position, and runway rather than personal income goals. Founders who
demonstrate financial discipline by prioritizing growth and extending runway often improve their
chances of attracting investment. For investors, the discussion reinforces the importance of
evaluating management compensation as a measure of capital efficiency and alignment with shareholder
interests. Both speakers conclude that in today's environment, founders who balance reasonable
compensation with disciplined capital allocation are best positioned to build sustainable,
investable businesses.]
Founder Compensation in a Capital-Constrained World: Balancing Salary, Runway, and Growth
][83]
[ [The exit number on the press release? It's almost never the number that actually hits your
account. 💸 88% of deals in 2024 and 2025 had a post-close purchase price adjustment. In this clip,
Dave Berkus and David Friedman explain why: ✅ Working capital adjustments are now standard in
nearly every transaction ✅ Leave too little cash in the deal → buyer claws it back from your
proceeds ✅ Holdbacks, earnouts, and adjustments quietly reshape the final payout ✅ The headline
price ≠ the take-home price If you're a founder thinking about an exit — or an investor banking on
one — this is the part of the deal nobody warned you about. ▶️ Full episode →

[ [In this episode of TCA Crossroads, David Friedman and Dave Berkus discuss what separates
investment-ready startups from those that are prematurely seeking capital. The conversation
highlights the importance of preparation, including building a credible team, validating
product-market fit, understanding customers, developing a concise elevator pitch, and establishing
realistic valuations before approaching investors. The hosts emphasize that investors fund execution
and evidence, not just ideas, and that founders who demonstrate focus, market understanding, and
coachability significantly improve their chances of raising capital. The discussion also explores
why investors frequently decline opportunities, including unrealistic financial projections, lack of
competitive analysis, poor capital planning, and founders who are unwilling to accept feedback.
Berkus and Friedman stress that entrepreneurs must understand the investment thesis of the investors
they are approaching and align their pitch accordingly. Key takeaways include the importance of
customer validation, realistic fundraising expectations, capital efficiency, and building long-term
relationships with investors rather than viewing fundraising as a transactional process.]
Working with Early-Stage Investors: The Right Way and the Wrong Way
][82]
[ [In this episode of TCA Crossroads, Dave Berkus and David Friedman explore one of the most
important—and often misunderstood—topics in entrepreneurship: founder compensation. Drawing on data
from Pilot's Fifth Annual Startup Founder Salary Report covering nearly 1,850 startups, they discuss
how founder salaries have shifted in response to a tougher fundraising environment and increased
focus on capital efficiency. The conversation highlights key findings, including declining founder
pay, the rise in bootstrapped companies, differences across funding stages, team sizes, industries,
and geographies, and the premium currently commanded by AI-related ventures. The discussion provides
valuable context for understanding how compensation should evolve as companies grow from pre-seed
through later stages. For entrepreneurs, the key takeaway is that compensation should be tied to the
company's stage, cash position, and runway rather than personal income goals. Founders who
demonstrate financial discipline by prioritizing growth and extending runway often improve their
chances of attracting investment. For investors, the discussion reinforces the importance of
evaluating management compensation as a measure of capital efficiency and alignment with shareholder
interests. Both speakers conclude that in today's environment, founders who balance reasonable
compensation with disciplined capital allocation are best positioned to build sustainable,
investable businesses.]
Founder Compensation in a Capital-Constrained World: Balancing Salary, Runway, and Growth

# Turning Point is a safe place where ALL survivors of domestic and intimate partner abuse and their
# children can find refuge.

Turning Point provides confidential resources and support for individuals and families in Lehigh and
Northampton counties. In fiscal year 2024–2025, we served more than 3,772 Lehigh Valley residents
through our trauma-informed, inclusive programs, which include: a 24-hour Helpline, Emergency Safe
House, Empowerment Counseling and Groups, Legal Advocacy, Education and Training, and Medical
Advocacy.

# Home

A community in which all relationships are safe, respectful and equitable,
where all people can live and thrive

# Turning Point is a safe place where ALL survivors of domestic and intimate partner abuse and their
# children can find refuge.

Turning Point provides confidential resources and support for individuals and families in Lehigh and
Northampton counties. In fiscal year 2024–2025, we served more than 3,772 Lehigh Valley residents
through our trauma-informed, inclusive programs, which include: a 24-hour Helpline, Emergency Safe
House, Empowerment Counseling and Groups, Legal Advocacy, Education and Training, and Medical
Advocacy.

[ View the 2024-2025 Annual Report ][50]

### **Our Mission is to eliminate domestic and intimate partner abuse in the Lehigh Valley through
### survivor empowerment, and community education and engagement.**

If you need help for a domestic or intimate partner abuse situation, please reach out to our:

Welcome to Vinfen

## The provider, employer, and partner of choice.

Established in 1977, Vinfen is a nonprofit, health and human services organization and a leading
provider of community-based services to individuals with mental health conditions, intellectual and
developmental disabilities, brain injuries, and behavioral health challenges. Our services and
advocacy promote the recovery, resiliency, habilitation, and self-determination of the people we
serve.

327

PROGRAMS AND SERVICES

14,000

PEOPLE SERVED PER YEAR

500

LOCATIONS IN MA & CT

## THIS IS VINFEN

Vinfen is one of the most dynamic and innovative health and human services organizations in the
country. With over 500+ locations in Massachusetts and Connecticut, we are a premier provider of
comprehensive services for adolescents and adults with disabilities or life challenges. We provide a
wide range of evidence-based programs in recovery, supported living, habilitation, education,
employment, clinical, and peer support to the populations we serve.

Specializing in medical laser technology, our product portfolio covers a wide range of applications,

imaging to vessel visualization and beyond.
